signals.headline: Samsara Launches Canadian Data Residency and Domestic Fulfillment Operations
signals.summary: Samsara announced expansion of Canadian operations including dedicated AWS Canada data centre for data hosting and domestic fulfillment partnerships. This development addresses data sovereignty requirements for Canadian public sector and regulated industry customers by enabling localized data storage and processing within Canadian jurisdiction.
signals.impact: Canadian public sector organizations and regulated industry clients using Samsara should review whether this Canadian data residency option meets their data sovereignty requirements and update vendor assessments accordingly.
